description.en: Canonical words of the Buddha translated into Tibetan (Degé Kangyur)

key: tradition/vajrayana
Buddhist tradition of the text, mirroring the app's onboarding choice 'Sanskrit & Tibetan scriptures'. Applied to root texts; the backend cascades it to their translations.

key: tradition/mahayana
Buddhist tradition of the text, mirroring the app's onboarding choice 'Chinese scriptures'. Applied to root texts; the backend cascades it to their translations.

key: tradition/theravada
Buddhist tradition of the text, mirroring the app's onboarding choice 'Pāli scriptures'. Applied to root texts; the backend cascades it to their translations.

key: practice/chant
Texts recited as practice in the WeBuddhist app; drives the Chants screen. Replaces the use of the Liturgy category for that purpose.
